key.name: blur-backend

key.name: blur-brightness
key.description: Background brightness only; text and icons remain unchanged.

key.name: surface-opacity
key.description: Background alpha only; never use actor opacity on text or icons.

key.name: update-frequency
key.description: Requested maximum blur capture rate in Hz. Zero means compositor-driven. Effective only if the backend supports throttling; never create a polling redraw loop.

key.name: resize-debounce-ms
key.description: Trailing debounce for geometry changes, not for driving animations.

key.name: panel-opacity

key.name: shadow-offset-x

key.name: panel-style
